answer_4.quote: We recruited 21 participants from the crowdsourcing platform Prolific to rank the three models... In each question, every option consists of the top-5 positively associated semantic poles from the three methods... We measured the effectiveness of our methodology in multiple ways. First, we calculated Kendall's W and the average rankings of these three methods...
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rank the three pipelines (ADAPTIVE AXES, token‑based semantic axes, randomized baseline) for each target country and domain based on the quality and relevance of the top‑5 semantic poles presented.
